text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate a "School Bus Loading Zone" on the west side of Palmer Avenue, between a point 37 metres south of Secord Avenue to a point 30 metres further south. The proposed changes will facilitate safe and efficient pick-up/drop-off activity for students of Secord Elementary School.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated a school bus loading zone to operate at all times on the west side of Palmer Avenue, between a point 37 metres south of Secord Avenue and a point 30 metres further south. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Palmer Avenue, between a point 37 metres south of Secord Avenue and a point 30 metres further south. 3. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the west side of Palmer Avenue between a point 40.9 metres south of a point opposite the south limit of Dentonia Park and Secord Avenue, to be in effect from Secord Avenue to a point 37 metres south of Secord Avenue, and from a point 67 metres south of Secord Avenue to Palmer Street.
